name: get_account
description: Get Account. Shows details of the top-level Huntress Account associated with your API credentials. GET /v1/account.

name: get_actor
description: Get Actor. Shows details of the entities associated with the supplied API credentials. It will only return the fields relevant to the current credentials. Each of `reseller`, `account`, and `user` is returned only when the supplied credentials are associated with that entity, so do not rely on any particular key being present. When the credentials are associated with an entity but are not permitted to read it, the key is still returned with every field replaced by `` — for example, credentials belonging.. For an API key this shows only the account, whichever key it is; use list_identities to test identity access. GET /v1/actor.

name: list_organizations
description: List Organizations. Shows details of Organizations belonging to the account associated with your API credentials. Organizations are Huntress's clients. Filter by exact name or key. GET /v1/organizations.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

name: get_organization
description: Get Organization. Shows details on a single Organization associated with your account. GET /v1/organizations/{id}.

name: list_agents
description: List Agents. Shows Agents associated with your account. Endpoint agents (computers). hostname is an exact match. GET /v1/agents.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account

platform.description: Filter by platform. One of windows, darwin, linux

name: get_agent
description: Get Agent. Shows details on a single Agent associated with your account. GET /v1/agents/{id}.

name: list_incident_reports
description: List Incident Reports. Shows Incident Reports associated with your account. Each report carries its full investigative summary in `body`, so keep limit small. GET /v1/incident_reports.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

indicator_type.description: Filter by indicator type. One of footholds, monitored_files, ransomware_canaries, antivirus_detections, process_detections, managed_identity, mde_detections, siem_detections, favicon_detections, behavioral_detections, email_security_detections, app_control, ai_misuse

status.description: Filter by status. One of sent, closed, dismissed, auto_remediating, deleting, partner_dismissed

severity.description: Filter by severity. One of low, high, critical

platform.description: Filter by platform. One of windows, darwin, microsoft_365, google, linux, email_security, other

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account

agent_id.description: Filter by agent ID within Huntress account

psa_ticket_eid.description: Filter by the external identifier (EID) of a ticket Huntress opened in your PSA — the identifier your PSA assigned to the ticket. Depending on the PSA, this may differ from the ticket number a technician sees. Matches the Incident Report the ticket was opened for. Tickets Huntress opened for anything other than an Incident Report, such as an escalation, will not match.

name: get_incident_report
description: Get Incident Report. Shows details on a single Incident Report associated with your account. Unlike the list endpoint, this includes Incident Reports that have been sent back to the Huntress SOC — for example after their remediation plan was rejected — which report a `status` of `draft`. GET /v1/incident_reports/{id}.

name: list_incident_report_comments
description: List Incident Report Comments. Shows the comments on a single Incident Report. GET /v1/incident_reports/{id}/comments.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

name: list_remediations
description: List Remediations. Shows details of Remediations belonging to a single Incident Report. GET /v1/incident_reports/{incident_report_id}/remediations.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

types.description: Filter by type of remediation. Must be a comma-separated string containing the values: assisted, manual, containment

statuses.description: Filter by status of remediation. Must be a comma-separated string containing the values: unapproved, approved, completed, failed, cancelled

name: get_remediation
description: Get Remediation. Shows details for a single Remediation belonging to a single Incident Report GET /v1/incident_reports/{incident_report_id}/remediations/{remediation_id}.

Escalations are used to notify Huntress account administrators that a situation requires their attention. Below are some common use cases: - Security Operation Centers (SOC) suspect that an application being flagged as malicious is a false positive, and we want to get your authorization to allow-list the application moving forward. - A potentia.. GET /v1/escalations.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

Depending on the PSA, this may differ from the ticket number a technician sees. name: get_escalation
description: Get Escalation. Shows details on a single Escalation associated with your account. GET /v1/escalations/{id}.

name: list_signals
description: List Signals. Shows details of Signals belonging to the account associated with your API credentials. Signals are used to highlight interesting user or system behaviors that an analyst can reference during a cyber investigation. A detected Signal could be as broad and low fidelity as the detection of a command line user running whoami, or it could be as specific and high fidelity as detecting a known malware file. GET /v1/signals.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

investigated_at_min.description: Filter by an ISO-8601 formatted date string that represents the lower bound of the search range for the investigated_at date.

investigated_at_max.description: Filter by an ISO-8601 formatted date string that represents the upper bound of the search range for the investigated_at date.

entity_type.description: Filter by the entity type that the Signal originated from. This filter can be used without specifying entity_id.

entity_id.description: Filter by the entity ID that the Signal originated from. Must be used in tandem with entity_type parameter.

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account

types.description: Filter by the types of Signal, must be comma-separated string containing the values: `Antivirus, Process Insights, Managed ITDR, Footholds, MDE Detections, SIEM, Ransomware Canaries, Favicon Detections, Attack Disruptions, App Control`

statuses.description: Filter by status. Must be comma-separated string containing the values: `reported`, `closed`

name: get_signal
description: Get Signal. Shows details of a single Signal belonging to the account associated with your API credentials. Signals are used to highlight interesting user or system behaviors that an analyst can reference during a cyber investigation. A detected Signal could be as broad and low fidelity as the detection of a command line user running whoami, or it could be as specific and high fidelity as detecting a known malware file. GET /v1/signals/{id}.

name: list_reports
description: List Summary Reports. Shows Summary Reports associated with your account. GET /v1/reports.

period_min.description: Filter by an ISO-8601 formatted date string that represents the lower bound of the search range for the period date.

name: list_external_ports
description: List External Ports. Shows external port records from External Recon scans associated with your account. GET /v1/external_ports.

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account

risky_service.description: Filter by whether the detected service is considered risky.

service.description: Filter by the detected service name (lowercase Shodan module name, e.g. 'ssh', 'http', 'rdp').

name: get_external_port
description: Get External Port. Shows details on a single external port record associated with your account. GET /v1/external_ports/{id}.

name: list_platform_actions
description: List Platform Actions. Shows Platform Actions associated with your account. Additional details for a specific platform action can be obtained by using the **GET Platform Action** endpoint. Platform Actions are operational issues that prevent Huntress from fully monitoring or protecting your environment. They notify account administrators of configuration or health problems that require their attention. Common examples include: - The Huntress security platform is unable to send incident reports to your PSA system an.. GET /v1/platform_actions.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

name: get_platform_action
description: Get Platform Action. Shows details on a single Platform Action associated with your account. GET /v1/platform_actions/{id}.

name: list_unwanted_access_rules
description: List Unwanted Access Rules. Shows Unwanted Access Rules associated with your account. Unwanted Access Rules govern how Huntress responds to identity access attempts matching specific attributes. Each rule targets a category (country, vpn, ip_address) and declares a determination — `expected` or `unauthorized` — at the account, organization, or identity scope. GET /v1/unwanted_access_rules.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account.

identity_id.description: Filter results to rules attached directly to this identity.

status.description: Filter by rule status as shown in the Portal UI.

scope.description: Filter by the level the rule is attached to.

category.description: Limit results to a single rule category.

country_code.description: Filter by country code value (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Implies `category=country`.

vpn.description: Filter by VPN (tunnel operator) value. Implies `category=vpn`.

ip_address.description: Filter by IP Address value. Implies `category=ip_address`.

logic.description: Filter by rule logic. `standard` returns rules with explicit values, `catchall` returns rules matching all values in a category, and `catchall_exception` returns rules that exclude specifically set values from an existing catchall rule. Omit this parameter to include all three.

name: get_unwanted_access_rule
description: Get Unwanted Access Rule. Shows details on a single Unwanted Access Rule associated with your account. GET /v1/unwanted_access_rules/{id}.

name: list_known_vpns
description: List Known VPNs and Proxies. Returns the list of VPN and proxy operators recognized by Huntress. Use any value from this list as the `vpn` parameter when creating an Unwanted Access Rule. Values accepted by the `vpn` filter of list_unwanted_access_rules. GET /v1/known_vpns.

name: list_memberships
description: List Memberships. Shows a list of memberships. By default, this endpoint returns both account and organization memberships, but if an organization ID is supplied, it will return only organization memberships, instead. The example return value shows both an organization and an account, but a given membership will only have one or the other. GET /v1/memberships.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID to return only memberships for that organization.

user_id.description: Filter by user ID to return only memberships for that user.

name: get_membership
description: Get Membership. Shows details on a single Membership associated with your account or organization. GET /v1/memberships/{id}.

name: list_remote_access_connections
description: List Remote Access Connections. This endpoint provides informational data only pertaining to when Huntress observes a given remote access tool running on a given host. Please note: results returned are capped at 500 total in descending order by last_seen_at, and pagination is not supported. GET /v1/remote_access/connections.

last_seen_at_min.description: The earliest time Huntress observed the remote access tool running on a monitored host.

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account

name: list_siem_log_sources
description: List SIEM Log Sources. Shows the SIEM log sources associated with an account. This endpoint requires a user-based API key with the appropriate permissions to access this endpoint. GET /v1/siem/log_sources.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

only_for_account.description: Filter by Log Sources that are only configured for an account and not configured for any organizations.

organization_id.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account.

type_code.description: Filter by Log Sources of a specific type using its machine-readable code.

name: get_siem_log_source
description: Get Log Source. Shows details on a single Log Source associated with your account. GET /v1/siem/log_sources/{id}.

name: list_invoices
description: List Account Invoices. Shows Invoices associated with your account. GET /v1/invoices.

limit.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

page_token.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

status.description: Filter by status. One of processing, open, paid, voided, failed, partial_refund, full_refund

has_usage.description: When true, returns only invoices with usage (subscription-cycle invoices). When false, returns only invoices without usage (manually-created invoices).

name: get_invoice
description: Get Account Invoice. Shows details on a single Invoice associated with your account. GET /v1/invoices/{id}.
